subject.title: Add SQLite snapshot artifacts under backup

question: Should OpenClaw ship `openclaw backup sqlite snapshot` as a core public backup primitive now, wait for the Scout/Lobster pilot and stress harness, or move this capability to a host/plugin-owned surface?
rationale: The code is a new core backup/restore surface for sensitive SQLite state, and the PR body explicitly says pilot evidence should decide whether the long-term surface is core, host-owned plugin, or both.

options.title: Keep draft for pilot plus repairs
options.body: Remove the mechanical blockers now, but keep the PR draft until maintainers review Scout/Lobster and stress evidence for the core boundary.

options.title: Sponsor core MVP now
options.body: After the two blockers are fixed, a maintainer can explicitly accept the security/session-state merge risk and proceed with core review.

options.title: Move to host/plugin surface
options.body: Close or replace this core PR if the pilot shows the command belongs in a host-owned plugin or ClawHub package instead.

recommendation.title: Keep draft for pilot plus repairs
recommendation.body: Remove the mechanical blockers now, but keep the PR draft until maintainers review Scout/Lobster and stress evidence for the core boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Galin already performed the maintainer review pass on this exact artifact contract and is the clearest person in the live discussion to arbitrate the next review step.
